long.summary: Tea began in southwest China, where wild Camellia sinensis grew in the hills of Yunnan, and legend credits the emperor Shennong with a first cup around 2737 BCE, when leaves blew into his boiling water.

details.text:
Whatever the truth of that story, by the **Han dynasty** tea was a medicine, and by the Tang it was a daily drink across China.

b1.title: Run a command on your PC
b1.detail:
gh repo create notes --private
cd notes
git status
b1.purpose: Creates a repository called notes on your GitHub, so it can be copied to this PC.

b2.title: Run 3 commands on your PC
b2.detail:
git init
git add notes.md
git commit -m "First notes"
b2.purpose: Makes this folder a repository and saves the notes in it.
b2.said: The user approved this step. These commands now run without another card, each once, exactly as written: git init; git add notes.md; git commit -m "First notes". Anything else asks on its own card, including 1 of the ones you listed.
